provenance.source: Original one-atom V2000/V3000 records and deliberately malformed record authored for chematic
provenance.transformations: LF/CRLF; optional final delimiter; ordered selection, repeated indices, slices and boolean masks

minimization: Four valid one-atom records and one malformed slot distinguish positional errors, duplicate reads, both CTAB versions, fields and order

oracle.settings: SdfDataset.open defaults; __getitem__ container errors raise; batches(size, errors=keep)

expected.tolerance: exact selection order, masks, strings and source indices; parser error messages are engine-specific
